scope: Terrain joins, closed outer-wall seams, material-aware player footfall and landing dust

changes.relief_refresh_guards: Retire safely if the native support is disabled, becomes one-way or stops being a rectangle
changes.outer_mass_fix: Remove the two-pixel inset on both sides so opaque terrain meets the existing physical boundary
changes.notes: Registered route and terrain-edge atlases are reused. Dust uses real physics-ray contacts and slope normals. No particle nodes, collisions, save data, new controls or permanent footprints. All simulation belongs to the existing shared ambience driver.

tests.name: terrain_joints_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: All 39 rooms, 37 wall feet, 268 slope end caps, 35 inset painted backings, texture bounds, grounding, device clearance, stable re-entry, scaled/late-wall/device fixture and replaced native support

tests.name: ground_contact_fx_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: Real-player walking and landing, actual slope/material contacts, six palettes, idle/passive motion/warp/death/flight guards, bounded lifetime and 40/12 pool

tests.name: terrain_envelope_smoke.gd
tests.coverage: Exact opaque closure at both physical side boundaries, open bridges/platforms, unchanged native collision

tests.name: route_relief_physics_smoke.gd

tests.name: route_relief_world_smoke.gd

runtime_review.renderer: Godot 4.6.2 D3D12 Forward Mobile / NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU
runtime_review.notes: Four world compositions and two effects from actual player movement, not manually posed particles. The native sandbox logs certificate-store and shader-cache write warnings, but captures succeed without script errors. No frame-rate benchmark is claimed.
